CREATE TABLE `payment_wallet_addresses` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `chain` varchar(10) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `address_index` int NOT NULL,
  `address` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `custody_reference` varchar(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `custody_evidence_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `custody_verified_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `origin` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `imported_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_payment_wallet_chain_index` (`chain`,`address_index`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_payment_wallet_chain_address` (`chain`,`address`),
  KEY `fk_payment_wallet_migration_run` (`migration_run_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_payment_wallet_migration_run` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_wallet_address` CHECK (((char_length(`address`) > 0) and (length(`address`) = length(trim(`address`))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_wallet_chain` CHECK (((`chain` in (_utf8mb4'TRON',_utf8mb4'ETH',_utf8mb4'BSC',_utf8mb4'SOL')) and (length(`chain`) = (case `chain` when _utf8mb4'TRON' then 4 else 3 end)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_wallet_custody` CHECK ((((`custody_reference` is null) and (`custody_evidence_sha256` is null) and (`custody_verified_at_utc` is null)) or ((`custody_reference` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`custody_reference`)) > 0) and (`custody_evidence_sha256` is not null) and (`custody_verified_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_wallet_hashes` CHECK ((((`custody_evidence_sha256` is null) or regexp_like(`custody_evidence_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c')) and ((`source_sha256` is null) or regexp_like(`source_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c')))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_wallet_index` CHECK ((`address_index` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_wallet_origin` CHECK ((((`origin` = _utf8mb4'native') and (`created_at_utc` is not null) and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null)) or ((`origin` = _utf8mb4'legacy_import') and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_wallet_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
